title: SEC5: fancy-regex :regex match lacks compile-time ReDoS pattern validation
description: lib.rs compile() validates require extensions but does NOT validate :regex patterns for safe complexity. Patterns like (a+)+b compile successfully with fancy_regex::Regex::new() but cause catastrophic backtracking at eval time. Per bead n3vt.3 spec: 'extract the pattern Str(s) and call fancy_regex::Regex::new(s). If Err, return compile error.' This is implemented, but ReDoS patterns compile without error. The session-level sieve_eval_timeout_ms mitigates worst case but the validation gap remains. Priority: P1 (operator scripts only, but missing spec'd validation).
